name: Shop City Shopping Center
summary: Shop City Shopping Center is a community-focused shopping destination in Syracuse, NY, offering convenient access to everyday retail and services with extended operating hours. With a 3.9-star rating from over 2,300 reviews, it serves as a reliable neighborhood hub for local residents.
demographics: Shop City Shopping Center serves a diverse middle-income demographic in the Syracuse metropolitan area, attracting families and working professionals primarily between the ages of 25-54. The trade area draws from surrounding residential neighborhoods with a mix of homeowners and renters seeking convenient access to everyday shopping needs. Typical visitors include budget-conscious shoppers looking for value and convenience, with household incomes ranging from $40,000 to $75,000 annually. The center benefits from Syracuse's stable population base and serves as a neighborhood hub for routine shopping trips and essential services.
description: Shop City Shopping Center has been serving the Syracuse community as a reliable neighborhood shopping destination for local residents seeking convenient access to everyday retail and services. Located at 105 Shop City Plaza in Syracuse, New York, this community-oriented center provides a practical shopping environment with extended hours from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM to accommodate busy schedules. The center has earned a solid reputation among local shoppers, reflected in its 3.9-star rating from over 2,300 customer reviews, demonstrating its consistent role in meeting the daily needs of the surrounding neighborhoods. As a community gathering place, Shop City Shopping Center offers the accessibility and convenience that Syracuse residents have come to depend on for their regular shopping routines. The center's strategic location and commitment to serving the local market make it an integral part of the Syracuse retail landscape.
